meta.title: Save as draft with a schedule saved
gaps: Advance the event past its start time and verify that publishing then requires a new schedule.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Advance the event past its start time and verify that publishing then requires a new schedule.

steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation screen.
Provide the required project title so the draft can be identified and saved.
Apply a pricing template before adding the item.
Add the requested line item to the draft.
Complete the pricing sheet for the added item.
Save the configured event as a draft.
Return to the events list to reopen the saved draft.
Verify the saved event appears in Drafts.
Reopen the draft event from the Drafts tab.
Verify the reopened draft displays the saved 60-minute schedule.
